title: Final Release Verification (closing Stage 27 UNVERIFIED gaps)
decision: YELLOW — production-ready CONDITIONAL. Real-browser acceptance is now VERIFIED (full lifecycle + real XP mutations + double-click idempotency in Chromium 149, both viewports). GREEN remains withheld for three reasons: (1) live Groq AI is still UNVERIFIED (no GROQ_API_KEY in this environment), (2) the reverse-proxy trust topology (trust proxy=1 vs production XFF) remains a deployment prerequisite that cannot be demonstrated here, and (3) real-browser error auditing surfaced ONE pre-existing B-class functional defect that the Stage 27 code-only audit could not see: the object-storage media-serving endpoint (/api/social/objects/*) is gated behind requireAuth, so /

findings.description: Object-storage media cannot be served to /
findings.evidence: Real Chromium run: GET http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/social/objectsav -> 401 missing_bearer_header (2x per viewport, on leaderboard + feed pages). API log: auth.failed reason=missing_bearer_header path=/api/social/objectsav. Root cause in social.ts: router.use(requireAuth) at line 13 precedes router.use("/objects", handler) at line 311. A test-residue user (s24-...@x.com, avatar_url='av' from Stage 24) surfaced the broken request; any real uploaded avatar would 401 identically. Secondary: path-contract mismatch — getObjectEntityFile requires objectPath.startsWith('/objects/') but the frontend mediaUrl() strips that prefix, so the handler would 404 even if auth passed.
findings.root_cause: requireAuth is applied router-wide in social.ts before the object-serving route; media tags cannot carry a Bearer token. Additionally the frontend/backend object-path contract is inconsistent.
findings.resolution: NOT fixed in this pass — fixing requires (a) moving /objects before requireAuth AND (b) enforcing the ACL (public objects readable anonymously, private objects owner/group-only) in the handler, which is a security-sensitive change that cannot be end-to-end verified without the object-storage sidecar (F-27-09). This is beyond the 'final verification, no architecture changes' mandate and would risk weakening security if done unverified. Documented as a release blocker prerequisite.
findings.regression_test: after fix + sidecar: upload an avatar, verify renders (200) unauthenticated for public objects and 403/404 for private objects; add an integration test for object ACL enforcement.

remaining_unverified: Reverse-proxy trust topology (trust proxy=1 vs production XFF overwrite)
